app.tagline: Manage your projects. Know what to do now.

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE: The server sent an unexpected response.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The submitted data is not valid.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.ROUTE_NOT_FOUND: The requested resource does not exist.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.EMAIL_REQUIRED: Your account needs an email address.
errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: That email belongs to another account. If it is yours, verify it and try again.
errors.INVALID_CURSOR: The list has changed. Please reload the page.
errors.REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Something it refers to no longer exists.
errors.WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND: The workspace does not exist or you do not have access.
errors.INVALID_WORKSPACE_ID: The workspace link is not valid.
errors.INVALID_WORKSPACE_NAME: The workspace name must be between 1 and 100 characters.
errors.WORKSPACE_ADMIN_REQUIRED: Only workspace admins can do this.
errors.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND: That person is not a member of this workspace.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: A workspace needs at least one admin. Make someone else an admin first.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: The email address is not valid.
errors.INVALID_INVITATION_KIND: The invitation type is not valid.
errors.LINK_CANNOT_GRANT_ADMIN: An invitation link cannot grant the admin role. Invite that person by email.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: That person is already a member of the workspace.
errors.INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: The invitation does not exist or is no longer valid.
errors.INVITATION_EXPIRED: The invitation has expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
errors.INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation is for another email address. Sign in with the right account.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Verify your email address to accept the invitation.
errors.EMAIL_DELIVERY_FAILED: The invitation email could not be sent. Please try again in a few minutes.
